caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow dish or plate with a central decorative motif. At the center of the plate, there is a bird with a yellowish-brown body, green and brown wings, and a lighter-colored head. The bird is perched on stylized branches, which have numerous leaves shaded in green, brown, and touches of yellow. Surrounding the bird and branches, there is a circular band of hand-lettered text written in a dark brown script. The background of the plate is primarily a muted yellow-green color, with areas of brighter green and hints of blue, and the outer rim of the plate features concentric rings in brown, green, and yellow. The plate is placed on a plain, off-white background. The drawing is signed in cursive script at the lower right outside the plate with the name "M. L. Austin."
title: Pa. German Plate
